Safeguarding and ethical storytelling

We serve children, widows and vulnerable people. Their safety and dignity come before any communication.

  • Consent first

    No photo or story without the informed consent of the person, or of their guardian for a minor. It can be withdrawn at any time.

  • First names only

    Never a surname, a school, an address or an exact location.

  • Hope, not pity

    We show dignity, joy and resilience — never staged distress.

  • Screened volunteers

    Background checks for anyone in contact with minors [to confirm], and never one adult alone with a child.

  • Raise a concern

    Any concern can be reported in confidence to our safeguarding lead [to confirm].

Protect yourself from fraud

La Paix du Cœur will never ask you to pay with gift cards or cryptocurrency, and never publishes its bank details. If in doubt, write to our official address before giving.

Tax receipts: your questions

Will I receive a tax receipt?

Official receipts for income tax purposes will be issued if the association is registered with the Canada Revenue Agency [if registered — to confirm]. With Zeffy, the receipt is emailed automatically.

When will I receive it?

Immediately for an online gift through Zeffy. For monthly gifts and Interac e-Transfers, a yearly receipt is sent in February.

Do gifts in kind qualify for a receipt?

Under CRA rules, some gifts in kind can qualify if they are valued at fair market value. Please write to us before giving [to confirm].

What if I give by Interac e-Transfer?

Put your full name and email address in the transfer message so we can issue your receipt.
